title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 Business Analytics for AI spend, usage and value
summary: The briefing is supported by the roadmap and Microsoft's current Frontier preview documentation. The changed service description still supports its licensing and GCC caveats, and the access-control paths and spending-policy calls are documented.

claims.claim: Learn currently documents Business Analytics as a Frontier preview.

claims.claim: Frontier provides early access to Microsoft's AI innovations.

claims.claim: Business Analytics is a dedicated app for business decision makers and general managers.
claims.quote: Business Analytics is a dedicated app for business decision makers and general managers (GMs) to view and track the cost and usage of their organization's Microsoft AI services in one place.

claims.claim: The app has an Overview page.
claims.quote: Overview | How is my organization using AI, what is it costing, and what needs my attention?

claims.claim: The app has a Use cases page.
claims.quote: Use cases | What do people use Microsoft AI services for?

claims.claim: The app has a Cost & forecast page.
claims.quote: Cost & forecast | How is AI cost tracking against budget, and where is it likely to land?

claims.claim: The app has a Users & groups page.
claims.quote: Users & groups | Who is using AI services, and how intensely?

claims.claim: The app provides service-specific pages.
claims.quote: Single entry point per service. Each AI service has one dedicated page, so you can easily move from a summary to service-specific insights.

claims.claim: The app combines insights for licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot with usage-based AI services.
claims.quote: View insights across Microsoft 365 Copilot (per-user license) and usage-based AI services together, instead of switching between separate dashboards.

claims.claim: Copilot Cowork is one of the usage-based services covered.
claims.quote: usage-based AI services, such as Copilot Cowork, agents, and GitHub Copilot

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: General-availability rollout mechanics and default access have not been published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Business Analytics" general availability rollout licensing price GCC High DoD feature ID. Read introduction, manage/introduction and Microsoft Agent 365 service description; these describe preview access, not GA rollout mechanics.

claims.claim: The Cost & forecast figures exclude Microsoft Copilot per-user subscription licence costs.
claims.quote: The Cost & forecast page focuses on usage-based billing. Microsoft Copilot user subscription license costs aren't included.

claims.quote: For Microsoft 365 Copilot, cost shows as "Included in license" because it's covered by the per-user license.

claims.claim: The app offers a base forecast based on recent usage remaining consistent.
claims.quote: Base or steady forecast, which assumes future usage is consistent with recent usage.

claims.claim: The app offers a growth forecast.
claims.quote: Growth forecast, which allows recent usage growth to continue in the projection.

claims.claim: A spend-cap scenario estimates the impact of a monthly spending cap.
claims.quote: Spend cap: Estimate the impact of applying a monthly spending cap

claims.claim: A model-mix scenario estimates changes in model or provider usage.
claims.quote: Model mix: Estimate the impact of shifting usage between models or providers

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Scenarios change only the forecast comparison, not live access, routing, policies, budgets or limits.
claims.quote: A scenario changes only the forecast comparison. It doesn't modify live access, model routing, spending policies, budgets, or user limits.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Creating a reporting budget target does not create or modify a spending policy.
claims.quote: Creating a reporting budget target doesn't create or modify an enforced spending policy.

claims.claim: A reporting budget target does not enforce a spending limit.
claims.quote: A reporting budget target helps you analyze spending. Creating the target doesn't configure a spending policy or enforce a spending limit.

claims.claim: AI value is an estimate.
claims.quote: AI value is an estimate of the labor value associated with AI's contribution.

claims.claim: The cited AI value methodology is documented for Cowork, not Copilot assisted value.
claims.quote: This entire article applies to Cowork assisted hours and value, including customization. It does not apply to Copilot assisted hours and Copilot assisted value, including customization.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: AI value does not represent realized financial savings.
claims.quote: It doesn't represent realized cost savings, increased revenue, or a guaranteed return on investment.

claims.claim: The app provides cost-per-user reporting.
claims.quote: Daily cost per user | The average daily cost per user over the selected time period.

claims.claim: The app provides group-based cost views.
claims.quote:
Depending on the data available for your scope, cards can include:
- Job function
- Model
- Service
- Organization
- Group

claims.claim: The app provides model-based cost views.
claims.quote: The Model tab shows cost and activity by model provider. Expand a provider to see the models included beneath it.

claims.claim: Consumption insights are on by default for GMs.
claims.quote: Consumption insights are on by default for GMs.

claims.claim: Business leaders need an administrator to turn on consumption insights to see cost insights.
claims.quote: Cost, budget, and usage-based service insights appear only when consumption insights are turned on for your role. Consumption insights are on by default for GMs. For business leaders, an admin must turn them on.

claims.claim: Identification in a permission set decides whether users see identifiable or de-identified data.
claims.quote: Identification | Whether users can view identifiable data, such as individual names, where your policies allow it. When identification is off, users see de-identified data instead.

claims.claim: The Cost & forecast Users tab lists people with assigned usage limits.
claims.quote: The Users tab shows people who have an assigned usage limit.

claims.claim: The Users tab requires the viewer's role to permit access.
claims.quote: The Users tab under Spending limits appears when user limits are assigned and your role permits access.

claims.claim: Export is enabled by default.
claims.quote: Export is only available when it's enabled for employees using access management. It's enabled by default.

claims.claim: CSV download is a documented export option, subject to access and service availability.
claims.quote:
Depending on the selected service and your access, the app can provide the following export options:
- CSV download: Create and download a file containing the selected service data

claims.claim: An MCP connection is listed among the export options.
claims.quote: MCP connection: View the setup information for making the service data available through an MCP connection

claims.claim: Include user identifiers is off by default.
claims.quote: Because user identifiers are sensitive information, the setting is off by default.

claims.claim: Identifiable exports depend on the user's permissions.
claims.quote: If you don't have permission to export identifiable information, the setting isn't displayed and the export uses anonymized identifiers.

claims.claim: Effective Business Analytics access combines all valid assignments, including security-group policies.
claims.quote: A user can receive access from more than one source, such as a system-defined policy, a custom policy, or membership in a security group that's assigned to a policy. When this happens, the user's effective access is the combination of all of their valid assignments.

claims.claim: One Business Analytics assignment never removes access granted by another.
claims.quote: A capability that's turned on by any assignment is available to the user, and one assignment never removes access that another assignment grants.

claims.claim: Existing Viva Insights role assignments carry over to Business Analytics.
claims.quote: Users inherit the access and organizational scope of their existing roles from Viva Insights; role assignments don't need to be renewed.

claims.claim: Existing minimum group size settings carry over from Viva Insights.
claims.quote: existing tenant-level settings such as minimum group size carry over from Viva Insights, which continue to hide aggregated insights for groups smaller than your configured thresholds.

claims.claim: Insights analysts, Insights admins and other leaders or GMs not detected automatically need Global-admin-assigned access.
claims.quote:
Access assigned by a Global admin | - Insights analysts
- Insights admins

claims.claim: Global, AI and Viva Insights administrators can manage Business Analytics access.
claims.quote:
The following admin roles can view and manage access policies, permission sets, and partitions in Business Analytics:
- Global administrator
- AI administrator
- Viva Insights administrator

claims.claim: Manage > Access management > Permission sets > Manage > permission set > Export or Identification reaches the documented capability settings.
claims.quote: under Manage, select Access management. ... under Permission sets, select Manage. ... Open the permission set you want to change. ... Export | Whether users can export data from the app ... Identification | Whether users can view identifiable data

claims.claim: No Business Analytics permission-set or access-policy PowerShell/API automation is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Business Analytics" access policies permission sets PowerShell Microsoft Graph API. Read manage/access and Viva feature-access-management; results document in-app permission sets and general VFAM, not automation for these access policies.

claims.claim: Manage > Access management > policy > Actions > Edit is the documented route to edit a custom access policy.
claims.quote: In Business Analytics, on the left, under Manage, select Access management. ... On the Access management home page, find the policy in the table. Under Actions, select Edit.

claims.claim: Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > app and feature > Access setting > On or Off is the documented VFAM policy route.
claims.quote: select Viva from the settings menu. ... Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access. ... Select Create a policy. ... select the app and feature ... Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide disabling policy for the Viva Insights web app.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.claim: Microsoft says the Viva settings also apply to Business Analytics Frontier preview where applicable, and its admin page links VFAM for app on/off control.
claims.quote: The settings described below also apply to Agent 365 Business Analytics (Frontier preview) where applicable.

claims.claim: The pages checked do not name a Business Analytics-specific Viva feature ID.
claims.quote: Searched: "Business Analytics" "FeatureId" VivaInsights. Read feature-access-management, manage-access-policies, manage-settings-copilot-dashboard and Business Analytics manage/introduction; no Business Analytics-specific feature ID found.

claims.claim: Get-VivaModuleFeature -ModuleId VivaInsights lists supported Viva Insights feature IDs for confirmation.
claims.quote:
For example, to see which features are supported in Viva Insights, run the following cmdlet:
Get-VivaModuleFeature -ModuleId VivaInsights
Find the feature that you'd like to create an access policy for and make note of its featureID.

claims.claim: Copilot > Cost Management > Get Started > Activate the default spending policy for your organization > Set the monthly spending limit for this policy > Limit monthly spending reaches the default-policy limit setting.
claims.quote: go to Copilot and then the Cost Management node. ... select Get Started. ... Activate the default spending policy for your organization ... In the Set the monthly spending limit for this policy section ... Limit monthly spending

claims.claim: The policy PATCH can update periodLimit to set the policy limit.
claims.quote: The following properties can be updated: displayName, periodLimit, perUserLimit, and billingMethods.

claims.claim: The policy PATCH can update perUserLimit to set per-user limits.
claims.quote: The following properties can be updated: displayName, periodLimit, perUserLimit, and billingMethods.

claims.claim: The policy PATCH can update billingMethods to change funding.
claims.quote: Use this method to change updatable properties, including billingMethods.

claims.claim: Changing stored non-pay-as-you-go funding to include pay-as-you-go requires a complete billingInstrument.
claims.quote: When changing stored non-pay-as-you-go funding to include pay-as-you-go, supply a complete billingInstrument; no separate billing endpoint or action is used.

claims.claim: The PATCH does not define replacement of an already-pay-as-you-go billing instrument.

claims.claim: Manage > Configurations > Metric calculators > Cowork assisted hours and value > Edit calculator > Value calculator > Value metrics reaches the Cowork value display toggle.

claims.claim: The tenant-wide Cowork Value metrics toggle is off by default.
claims.quote: Administrators can control whether AI value metrics for Cowork are displayed to users in their organization. This setting applies across the tenant and is turned off by default.

claims.claim: Viva Insights admins can configure Cowork value metrics.
claims.quote: Viva Insights admins can configure Cowork value metrics.

claims.claim: Configuring Copilot value metrics requires both Viva Insights admin and Chief officer roles, or Global admin.
claims.quote: Only users who have both Viva Insights admins and Chief officer roles, or who are global admins, can configure Copilot value metrics.

claims.claim: No PowerShell or API automation for Business Analytics metric calculators is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Business Analytics" calculators privacy minimum group size API PowerShell. Read manage/configurations, reference/ai-value and Viva manage-access-policies; no calculator-configuration operation found.

claims.claim: Manage > Configurations > Privacy > Minimum group size reaches the tenant aggregation threshold.
claims.quote: under Manage, select Configurations. The page includes these tabs: ... Privacy ... Minimum group size is the minimum number of people that must be in a group before aggregated insights are shown.

claims.claim: Minimum group size does not apply to nonaggregated user-level insights.

claims.claim: No PowerShell or API automation for Business Analytics privacy settings is documented.
